name: search_datasets
description: Search Qatar government open data for datasets by keyword (population, economic indicators, trade, labor, environment, SDG social statistics). Returns dataset_ids (pass to query/dataset_info), bilingual English/Arabic titles, and record counts.

query.description: Keyword(s) to search dataset titles/descriptions, e.g. "population".

name: dataset_info
description: Get metadata for one Qatar government open data dataset (field schema with English/Arabic labels, record count, description) — call before query to learn the column names.

name: query
description: Query records from a Qatar government open data dataset with ODSQL. Filter (where), aggregate (group_by/select), sort (order_by), paginate (limit/offset). Field labels come back as label_en/label_ar — dataset_ids and field names stay in their native form.

select.description: ODSQL select/aggregation, e.g. `count(*) as n, sum(amount)`.
